verdict.rationale: Asana's app directory lists an Asana widget for Figma and FigJam that lets designers turn ideas into next steps (tasks) from inside the design tool, which covers part of working in Asana without switching apps. The listing does not show that project status itself can be updated or kept current from the design tool, and it gives no depth on the widget's actions. Live Figma embeds run the other way, bringing designs into Asana. missing for 10: documented ability to update task/project status from within the design tool, detailed first-party docs on the widget's actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can keep project status updated from my design tool without switching apps

citations.quote: Turn ideas into next steps with the Asana widget for Figma and FigJam.
